whyMatters.en: Pasadena hard-rock band that made two-handed tapping and high-gain precision a guitar-hero standard; Van Halen (1978) is the debut shock.
whyMatters.zh: 帕萨迪纳 hard-rock：把双手 tapping 与高增益精度做成吉他英雄标准；同名首专（1978）是出道冲击。

shortBio.en: Eddie Van Halen–era hard rock; Eruption is the technique showcase.
shortBio.zh: Eddie Van Halen 时期 hard rock；Eruption 是技术展示。

body.en:
Formed 1972. Debut album with Ted Templeman production put Eddie’s tapping, harmonics, and brown-sound midrange beside David Lee Roth’s showman vocal and Michael Anthony’s harmony.

Eruption (1978) is the instrumental citation. 1980s Roth-to-Hagar lineup change is a separate commercial chapter; the technique export is early and permanent.
body.zh:
1972 年组建。Ted Templeman 制作的首专把 Eddie 的 tapping、泛音与棕色中频，配上 David Lee Roth 的表演人声与 Michael Anthony 和声。

Eruption（1978）是器乐引用。1980 年代 Roth 到 Hagar 的阵容更替是另一商业章节；技术输出早且持久。
